answer: Finality should require attestations from a quorum of peers who share no referral kinship. Honest work rests on a basalt-hard base of independent witnesses; a sybil cluster is just a dune of identities all tracing to one seed, and kin cannot ratify kin. Lattice the grading like a trellis where every crossing node must be unrelated, and a lone operator's clones can never assemble the independent quorum a real contribution collects.
